title: Accessibility.
officialText:
The following elevators and lifts shall conform to ICC A117.1:
1. Passenger elevators, including destination-oriented elevators, required to be accessible by Chapter 11;
2. Limited-Use/Limited-Application (LULA) elevators permitted to be installed on an accessible route pursuant to Section
1109.6.1;
3. Platform lifts permitted to be installed on an accessible route pursuant to Section 1109.7; and
4. Private residence elevators serving within an individual dwelling unit in Groups R-2 and R-3 occupancies on an accessible
route.
